posts.title: 🚨 Only a Few Days Left: Data Confirmation Deadline Approaching
posts.summary: Only a few days left! Prior to August 13th, ALL parents/guardians need to confirm their student's information on file.
posts.author: Jeffrey Hromadka
posts.body:
Only a few days left! Prior to August 13th, ALL parents/guardians need to confirm their student's information on file. Please note that students will not be able to access their class schedules until this data confirmation is complete.

Next Steps:

  • Log in to your Aeries Portal using your email and password to verify your details.
  • Device Recommendation: We strongly suggest using a desktop or laptop computer for best results.

posts.title: 📣 26-27 Bus Route Information
posts.summary: Emails and letters with route assignments for students with general bus needs and eligibility have been sent out.
posts.author: Guadalupe Flores
posts.body:
~Emails and Letters with Route Assignments for students with general bus needs AND eligibility have been sent out~

Parents/Guardians can also access Bus Assignment information on Aeries after completing their Parent Data Confirmation - Under: Student Info → Student Supplemental

Full Bus Schedules for each school can be found on our District Website → SMJUHSD Transportation → Bus Schedules.

posts.title: 📬 Family Resource Center Monthly Bulletin (August)
posts.summary: The Family Resource Center monthly bulletin with the latest information, updates, upcoming events, and resources for August.
posts.author: SMJUHSD Family Resource Center
posts.body:
The Family Resource Center has created a monthly bulletin to help keep you informed with the latest information, updates, upcoming events, and resources. If you have questions or need help accessing any of the information listed, please don't hesitate to reach out; we are here to support you.

Our office is located at 829 S. Lincoln St Room 908, open Monday through Friday from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.

Attachments: FRC Bulletin - August 2026.pdf

posts.title: 🎪 Freshmen Parent Night - Wednesday August 5th 6PM
posts.summary: Welcome Class of 2030! Freshmen Parent Night is Wednesday August 5th at 6PM at PVHS in the library (English) and cafeteria (Spanish).
posts.author: Susan Hook
posts.body:
Welcome Class of 2030!

Freshmen Parent Night is Wednesday August 5th at 6PM at PVHS. The English presentation will be in the library and the Spanish presentation will be held in the cafeteria. Administrators and counselors will be presenting information on school policies, academics, ways parents can stay connected and will be available to answer questions.

posts.title: 📣 Welcome Back!
posts.summary: Welcome Back, Panthers! Dr. Robinson looks forward to seeing students on August 13th. See attached newsletter for critical info, policy updates, and important dates.
posts.author: Paul Robinson
posts.body:
Welcome Back, Panthers!

I hope you had a wonderful summer. I look forward to seeing you on August 13th. Before then, we have iPad distribution and schedules to look at. Please find attached our welcome back newsletter with critical information, policy updates and many important dates and times.

Thank you,
Dr. Robinson

Attachments: PVHS Welcome Back Newsletter 26-27.pdf | Spanish PVHS Welcome Back Newsletter 26-27.pdf
